def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    if p.log_min_dim < 6.0 or p.output_parallelism_deficit > 0.001:
        s = np.log2(t) * w[0]
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[1]
        s = s + np.log2(f.cta_edge_balance_time_ratio) * w[2]
        s = s + f.cta_shared_memory_fraction * w[3]
        s = s + f.smem_staging_overhead_ratio * w[4]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[5]
    else:
        s = np.log2(t) * w[6]
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[7]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.instruction_density * 1000.0) * w[8]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.mainloop_sync_count) * w[9]
    if p.roofline_ratio >= 1.0:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[10]
    else:
        s = s + f.spill_operand_traffic_ratio * w[11]
    if p.unaligned_access_fraction > 0.01:
        s = s + f.tm_regstaged * w[12]
    if p.shape_aspect_imbalance < 2.0:
        s = s + f.cta_tile_aspect_imbalance * w[13]
        s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * w[14]
        s = s + np.log2(f.cta_edge_balance_time_ratio) * w[15]
        s = s + f.launch_wave_utilization_deficit * w[16]
    else:
        s = s + f.cta_tile_aspect_imbalance * w[17]
        s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * w[18]
        s = s + np.log2(f.cta_edge_balance_time_ratio) * w[19]
        s = s + f.launch_wave_utilization_deficit * w[20]
    if p.working_set_l2_ratio > 1.0:
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * np.log2(1.0 + f.tm_l2_ratio) * w[21]
    else:
        s = s + f.raster_band_l2_pressure * w[22]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[23]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + np.log2(f.instruction_density) * w[0]
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[1]
    if p.output_parallelism_deficit > 0.001:
        if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
            s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[2]
            s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[3]
            s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[4]
            s = s + f.splitk_reduction_work_ratio * w[5]
            s = s + f.k_slice_padding_ratio * w[6]
            s = s + f.tile_alignment_traffic_deficit * w[7]
            s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[8]
        else:
            s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[9]
            s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[10]
            s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[11]
            s = s + f.splitk_reduction_work_ratio * w[12]
            s = s + f.k_slice_padding_ratio * w[13]
            s = s + np.log2(f.warp_output_work) * w[14]
    else:
        if p.roofline_ratio < 1:
            s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[15]
            s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[16]
            s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[17]
            s = s + f.splitk_reduction_work_ratio * w[18]
            s = s + f.k_slice_padding_ratio * w[19]
            s = s + f.tile_alignment_traffic_deficit * w[20]
            s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[21]
        else:
            s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[22]
            s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[23]
            s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[24]
            s = s + f.splitk_reduction_work_ratio * w[25]
            s = s + f.k_slice_padding_ratio * w[26]
            s = s + np.log2(f.warp_output_work) * w[27]
    order_dram = np.minimum(
        np.log2(1.0 + f.dram_w1_hz_ratio),
        np.log2(1.0 + f.dram_w1_id_ratio)
    )
    if p.operand_l2_pressure < 1:
        s = s + order_dram * (1.0 + f.raster_band_l2_pressure) * (1.0 + f.launch_tail_deficit) * w[28]
        s = s + np.minimum(f.a_refetch_bw_demand, f.b_refetch_bw_demand) * w[29]
    else:
        s = s + order_dram * (1.0 + f.raster_band_l2_pressure) * (1.0 + f.launch_tail_deficit) * w[30]
        s = s + np.minimum(f.a_refetch_bw_demand, f.b_refetch_bw_demand) * w[31]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[32]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + np.log2(f.edge_compute_padding_ratio) * w[0]
    s = s + f.cta_wave_tail_fraction * w[1]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + 1000.0 * f.barrier_work_density) * w[2]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + 1000.0 * f.instruction_work_density) * w[3]
    s = s + np.log2(f.operand_stride_transaction_ratio) * w[4]
    s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_stage_time_ratio) * w[5]
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[6]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        s = s + np.maximum(f.a_refetch_bw_demand, f.b_refetch_bw_demand) * w[7]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_l2_footprint_ratio) * w[8]
    else:
        s = s + np.maximum(np.maximum(f.occupancy_deficit, f.register_file_pressure), f.shared_memory_pressure) * w[9]
    if p.output_parallelism_deficit < 0.001:
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[10]
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[11]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[12]
    else:
        s = s + f.splitk_roofline_log_time * w[13]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[14]
        s = s + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio * w[15]
    s = s + f.has_spill * w[16]
    return s
